activity.notes: Gwon Yul won the Battle of Haengju on 12 February 1593 and was promoted to Dowonsu in June that year. Because his later Dowonsu tenure was interrupted and resumed, ATLAS uses 1593 as the clean representative military-command year rather than asserting a false continuous office term.

sources.title: 권율
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture records Gwon Yul's victory at Haengju in 1593 and his promotion to Dowonsu in June of that year.
